interface.signature: KnightPos: List[int], TargetPos: List[int], N: int -> int

preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard N must be between 1 and 1000.
The initial position of the Knight must be within the bounds of the chessboard.
The target position of the Knight must be within the bounds of the chessboard.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of steps required for the Knight to reach the target position.
The return value must be a non-negative integer or -1 if the target is unreachable.
